title: Services and prices
subtitle: The catalogue Feblio will use to prepare quotes. Each service keeps its price as versions with validity dates.

empty.title: No services yet
empty.body: Create your first service or import the catalogue from a CSV or Excel file.

readOnly: Your account can view and export the catalogue, but not modify it.

editor.codeHint: Unique identifier within your company. It cannot be changed later.
editor.requiresHumanReview: Human review required before sending the quote
editor.validFromHint: Leave empty to apply it today. With a future date, the current price stays in force until then.
editor.willCreateVersion: Saving will create a new price version.

history.title: Price history for {{code}}
history.empty: This service has no price versions yet.
history.immutable: Previous versions are never modified: they record the price that applied.

categories.title: Categories
categories.empty: You have not created any categories yet. They are yours: for example Employment law, Refurbishment, Engineering, Accounting, Licences or Consultancy.
categories.suggestions: Examples: Employment law · Refurbishment · Engineering · Accounting · Licences · Consultancy
categories.modeClear: Leave those services without a category
categories.deleteBody_one: {{count}} service uses this category. Choose what to do before deleting it.
categories.deleteBody_other: {{count}} services use this category. Choose what to do before deleting it.

import.title: Import catalogue
import.intro: Upload a CSV or Excel file. It is processed in your browser: the file is never sent to a server.
import.limits: Up to {{mb}} MB and {{rows}} rows. Formulas are never executed.
import.previewIntro: Check the result before confirming. If any row has errors, nothing is saved.
import.done: Import finished: {{created}} created, {{updated}} updated, {{versions}} new price versions.
import.blocked: Fix the errors in the file: no row has been saved.
import.tooLarge: The file is larger than {{mb}} MB.
import.tooManyRows: The file has more than {{rows}} rows.
import.unreadable: The file could not be read. Check that it is a CSV or XLSX file.
import.empty: The file has no data rows.
import.templateHint: Not sure where to start? Download the template.

confirm.deactivateBody: The service will no longer be offered, but its price history is kept.
confirm.deleteBody: The service and all its price versions will be deleted. This cannot be undone.
confirm.deleteBlocked: This service has already been used: it can only be deactivated.

errors.loadList: The catalogue could not be loaded.
errors.loadHistory: The price history could not be loaded.
errors.saveService: The service could not be saved.
errors.savePrice: The price could not be saved.
errors.saveCategory: The category could not be saved.
errors.deleteService: The service could not be deleted.
errors.deleteCategory: The category could not be deleted.
errors.import: The catalogue could not be imported.
errors.migrationMissing: Migration 0018 has not been applied (function not found).
errors.catalog_forbidden: Your account cannot modify the catalogue.
errors.no_company: Your account is not linked to a company.
errors.unauthenticated: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.
errors.service_not_found: The service does not exist or does not belong to your company.
errors.category_not_found: The category does not exist or does not belong to your company.
errors.price_version_not_found: There is no scheduled price version.
errors.duplicate_code: A service or category with that code already exists.
errors.invalid_code: The code accepts letters, numbers, hyphen and underscore only (2 to 30 characters).
errors.invalid_name: Enter a name of up to 200 characters.
errors.invalid_price: Check the price: it must be a valid amount.
errors.invalid_currency: The currency must be a 3-letter ISO code (EUR, USD…).
errors.invalid_tax: Check the tax and its rate.
errors.invalid_range: The price must sit between the minimum and the maximum.
errors.invalid_duration: The duration must be a number of minutes.
errors.invalid_items: Check the list items: some text is missing.
errors.service_in_use: The service has already been used: it can only be deactivated.
errors.category_in_use: The category is in use: reassign or unlink its services.
errors.price_overlap: There is already a price version for that date.
errors.price_past_date: Validity cannot start in the past.
errors.import_too_large: The import exceeds the maximum number of rows.
errors.import_failed: The row could not be processed.
errors.profile_identity_forbidden: You cannot change your role from your profile.
errors.company_role_forbidden: You cannot change your internal company role.
